title: Open Day + Good News
content:
Our community is growing! Recently, 5 new user groups were approved: Armenia, Cameroon, Canada, Croatia, and Cyprus, and more are coming soon. 

Curious to learn more? Cameroon and Canada will introduce themselves on Friday during the QGIS Open Day, and we'll also have a special session with Tim Sutton on how the QGIS.org Foundation works, including the PSC, AGMs, and how new user groups are created (spoiler: it involves a lot of very motivated, awesome people).

Click the link for details!
